bio: Graze Restaurant and Bar at Hilton Cardiff lies at the heart of the city overlooking Cardiff’s historic Castle and within walking distance of Cardiff’s famous shopping district. Choose to enjoy your tea in the relaxed ambience of Graze Restaurant with views over the Castle or the sophisticated Graze Bar. Our pastry chefs have created a delicious tea inspired by our local heritage and using the best locally sourced ingredients. Guests can savour seasonal finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and exquisite cakes and pastries. Our tea is made from the freshest rolled whole leaves - two leaves and a bud from the top of the tea plant, gently rolled and dried. The result is a much better tea and a richer, tastier cup.
